## The patch pipeline is an intent store, not a code generator: agents edit source… — 2026-07-25 (parent 1426a0e67d9b)

The patch pipeline is reframed as an intent store rather than a code generator. `Edits.backend` now defaults to `"record"` instead of `"llm"`; `make_backend` refuses `"record"` loudly since it is not a generating backend. `record_intent` (new in `pipeline`) archives pending notes as applied session-log rows and clears the queue without touching source. `patch_apply_cmd` routes the `record` default to `record_intent`; `TrieTools.commit` gains the same short-circuit before the apply lock.

A new `trie/intent_gate` module provides `touched_symbols` (detects semantic-body changes vs HEAD including untracked files and deletions, exempting `__module__`), `evaluate` (returns `IntentReport` of uncovered symbols), and status constants `MODIFIED`/`ADDED`/`REMOVED`. `intent_cmd` exposes this as a blocking pre-commit CLI. `PRE_COMMIT_HOOK_BLOCK` gains the gate between `verify` and the diff write.

`patch_create_cmd` adds `--gone` to archive deletion intent directly for removed symbols that have no graph row.
